verdict.rationale: CrewAI is an agent framework and platform rather than a standalone coding agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never documents CrewAI running as an MCP server or offering a first-party MCP endpoint. The `mcps` field on agents is MCP client-side tool consumption, which belongs to a separate story and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
